name: Godspeed You! Black Emperor

whyMatters.en: Montreal collective formed in 1994. F♯ A♯ ∞ (1997) and Lift Your Skinny Fists Like Antennas to Heaven (2000) set Constellation long-form post-rock: field recordings, spoken samples, and slow orchestral builds instead of verse-chorus.
whyMatters.zh: 蒙特利尔集体，1994 年成立。《F♯ A♯ ∞》（1997）与《Lift Your Skinny Fists Like Antennas to Heaven》（2000）定下 Constellation 大型 post-rock：田野录音、口语采样与缓慢管弦渐强，而非主副歌。

lyricQuotes: The car's on fire and there's no driver at the wheel
And the seats were stolen by convertibles

shortBio.en: Montreal post-rock collective; East Hastings is an early drone landmark.
shortBio.zh: 蒙特利尔 post-rock 集体；《East Hastings》是早期 drone 地标。

body.en:
Godspeed You! Black Emperor has been active since 1994 on Constellation Records. Early releases use spoken samples, tape hiss, and slow orchestral builds rather than verse-chorus song length.

East Hastings (1998) and Lift Your Skinny Fists Like Antennas to Heaven (2000) are the main reference points. Membership is fluid; crescendo structure plus found sound is the constant. A hiatus ran 2003–2010; reunion albums and tours followed in the 2010s.
body.zh:
Godspeed You! Black Emperor 自 1994 年起在 Constellation 厂牌活动。早期作品用口语采样、磁带底噪与缓慢管弦渐强，而非主副歌长度。

《East Hastings》（1998）与《Lift Your Skinny Fists Like Antennas to Heaven》（2000）是主要参照。成员流动；crescendo 结构加拾得声音是常量。2003–2010 年停顿，2010 年代起重组专辑与巡演。

note.en: Urban field samples and slow drone on F♯ A♯ ∞.
note.zh: 城市田野采样与慢 drone，出自《F♯ A♯ ∞》。

note.en: Lift Your Skinny Fists opening: orchestral swell and tape hiss as structure.
note.zh: 《Lift Your Skinny Fists》开场：管弦 swell 与磁带底噪作结构。

note.en: Spoken-word sample over drone; Constellation-era political document.
note.zh: 口语采样叠 drone；Constellation 时期政治文献。

body.en:
Godspeed treats post-rock as long-form composition: field recordings, spoken samples, and sides often past 20 minutes.

F♯ A♯ ∞ (1997) and Lift Your Skinny Fists (2000) define the early Constellation sound.

There is no frontman—collective credits and a rotating lineup. East Hastings uses urban field audio; Storm opens the double album with orchestral 延音.
body.zh:
Godspeed 把 post-rock 当作大型曲式：田野录音、口语采样，单面常超过 20 分钟。

《F♯ A♯ ∞》（1997）与《Lift Your Skinny Fists》（2000）定义早期 Constellation 声音。

无 frontman——集体署名与轮换编制。《East Hastings》用城市田野音频；《Storm》以管弦 延音 开双专。

body.en:
First run 1994–2003: Menuck, Moya, Amar, Girt, Trudeau, Pezzente, plus expanded live ensemble.

Hiatus 2003–2010; reunion tours restore the core with extra strings and glockenspiel.

Menuck also leads A Silver Mt. Zion—shared personnel across projects. Live shows use dark rooms, film projections, and little banter.
body.zh:
1994–2003 首轮：Menuck、Moya、Amar、Girt、Trudeau、Pezzente，加扩展现场编制。

2003–2010 停顿；重组巡演恢复核心并加额外弦乐与钟琴。

Menuck 亦领 A Silver Mt. Zion——项目间共享人事。现场暗场、投影、少闲聊。

body.en:
European and North American post-rock that treats samples and silence as compositional material often cites Godspeed.

Sonic Youth’s noise and Radiohead’s ambient turns are distant cousins; Godspeed adds anarchist politics and Constellation’s release infrastructure.

Mogwai and Explosions in the Sky share crescendo writing; Godspeed keeps longer forms and found sound. Citation peaks cover the 1997–2000 first run and 2010s reunion albums.
body.zh:
把采样与沉默当作作曲材料的欧美 post-rock 常引用 Godspeed。

Sonic Youth 噪声与 Radiohead ambient 转向是远亲；Godspeed 加上无政府政治与 Constellation 发行体系。

Mogwai 与 Explosions in the Sky 共享 crescendo 写法；Godspeed 保持更长形式与拾得声音。引用高峰覆盖 1997–2000 首轮与 2010 年代重组专辑。
